ACME GLOBAL TECHNOLOGIES - ANNUAL COMPREHENSIVE FINANCIAL REPORT 2024
SECTION 1: EXECUTIVE FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE & HIGHLIGHTS
In fiscal year 2024, our total consolidated revenue reached $158.4 million, representing a 14.2% increase year-o
Operating expenses were maintained at $64.2 million through operational discipline and automated infrastructure
Net profit was $42.5 million in Q4 2024, representing an all-time record quarterly net earnings for the company.
Operating margin expanded by 340 basis points to 28.6% across our enterprise solutions portfolio.
The Enterprise AI segment generated $54.8 million with 98.4% annual subscription renewal rate.
SECTION 2: CASH FLOW & CAPITAL ALLOCATION
Free cash flow conversion stood at 84% of EBITDA, providing $38.2 million in liquid reserves.
Research and Development expenditure was $21.5 million, focused on next-generation agentic orchestration.
